Average hard sets per week. The grey zone is 10 to 20 sets, the range where research finds the best muscle growth. A set where the muscle assists counts as half, and a set below RPE 6 does not count.
Log RPE or RIR with your sets to see how close to failure you train.
Reps in reserve, last 4 weeks. Sets close to failure (0 to 3) work best for muscle growth, while proximity to failure matters less for strength (Robinson et al. 2024).
Set weight relative to the exercise\'s best estimated 1RM, last 4 weeks. Above 85 percent is maximal strength training.
Total of the best estimated 1RM of the three lifts in the last 12 weeks, adjusted for body weight (%1$s). Use it to compare with others; for your own progress, look at the exercise trend.

Saving workouts needs the Health Connect app or a newer version of it.

Apolon saves workouts you finish on your phone and the weight you enter, and reads cardio workouts from other apps (with distance, calories and heart rate), weight and height. The first time it does this for the last 30 days of workouts and a year of measurements. Health Connect data stays on your phone only: it isn\'t included in backups, isn\'t shared and isn\'t used for advertising.
Without permissions, Apolon can\'t save to Health Connect. You can change them in Health Connect.

If you allow it, Apolon saves workouts you finish on your phone (time, duration, strength and cardio parts, name) and the weight you enter in the app to Health Connect. From Health Connect it reads cardio workouts from other apps (time, distance, active calories and average heart rate), body weight and height, to show them in your history and body tracking.

Data that\'s read is stored only in a local database on your phone. It isn\'t sent to anyone, isn\'t used for advertising or marketing, isn\'t sold and isn\'t included in backups. You can revoke permissions in Health Connect at any time, and Apolon works without them.

The number is the number of hard sets. A set in which the muscle assists counts as half, and a set with RPE below 6 does not count. Level and color: 1–2, 3–5, 6–9 and 10 or more sets.
How hard the whole workout was, from 1 to 10. Effort times duration is the training load (Foster et al. 2001).
Hard sets are working sets, excluding those with RPE below 6. Cardio exercises don\'t count as sets.

Exclude exercises you don\'t want records for, such as warm-ups or exercises you do only for technique.
Records count from the fourth time you do an exercise and when the improvement is at least 1 percent. The main record is the estimated 1RM, and the workout summary highlights at most three records.

The detailed view adds advice, muscles (map and sets), strength trend, effort and set intensity, and DOTS points. On the exercise chart it adds 1RM, volume, range choice, comparison, a rep-record table and relative strength, and in the workout rest between sets and an effort rating. DOTS points appear once sex is chosen in Profile and body weight is logged in Body.
Apolon can’t silence other apps’ notifications. Android’s Do Not Disturb does that, and on newer phones Modes, which can turn on by schedule.
